columns.name: id
columns.description: Record ID; the key of the table. It depends only on what defines the candidate.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Readable label: topology__nodes__edges, or the file name.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Where the structure comes from: pormake or cifs.

columns.name: topology
columns.description: Net the structure was assembled on; empty for existing CIFs.

columns.name: nodes
columns.description: Node building blocks, + between several.

columns.name: edges
columns.description: Edge building blocks, + between several; empty without edges.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Original file inside cif_dir; empty for assembled structures.

columns.name: n_atoms
columns.description: Atoms in the unit cell.

columns.name: formula
columns.description: Formula of the unit cell, Hill order.

columns.name: expected_formula
columns.description: Sum of the building blocks; empty for existing CIFs.

columns.name: linker_smiles
columns.description: Canonical SMILES of the linkers when they are known, ; between several.

columns.name: node_rmsd
columns.description: Largest node-to-vertex misfit reported by PORMAKE.

columns.name: cif_path
columns.description: Path of the structure file, relative to the folder that holds the table.

columns.name: generate_status
columns.description: Whether the structure was built or read: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: generate_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

columns.name: density
columns.description: Density from the cell and the atomic masses.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: Cell volume.

columns.name: cell_a
columns.description: Cell length a.

columns.name: cell_b
columns.description: Cell length b.

columns.name: cell_c
columns.description: Cell length c.

columns.name: cell_alpha
columns.description: Cell angle alpha.

columns.name: cell_beta
columns.description: Cell angle beta.

columns.name: cell_gamma
columns.description: Cell angle gamma.

columns.name: qc_min_distance
columns.description: Shortest interatomic distance.

columns.name: qc_n_close_pairs
columns.description: Pairs of atoms closer than qc.min_distance.

columns.name: qc_n_overlaps
columns.description: Heavy-heavy or H-H pairs closer than qc.min_distance_heavy.

columns.name: qc_n_nonbonded_contacts
columns.description: Non-bonded pairs closer than allowed.

columns.name: qc_n_components
columns.description: Connected components of the bond network.

columns.name: qc_n_isolated_atoms
columns.description: Atoms without any bond.

columns.name: qc_n_bad_h
columns.description: H atoms that do not have exactly one neighbour.

columns.name: qc_n_bad_c
columns.description: C atoms with fewer than 2 or more than 4 non-metal neighbours.

columns.name: qc_n_short_bonds
columns.description: Compressed covalent bonds (reported, not a check).

columns.name: qc_composition_ok
columns.description: The formula equals the sum of the building blocks.

columns.name: qc_node_rmsd_ok
columns.description: The node misfit is within qc.max_node_rmsd.

columns.name: qc_pass
columns.description: No enabled structural check failed. Not a statement about stability or synthesis.

columns.name: qc_reasons
columns.description: The failed checks, separated by ; .

columns.name: qc_status
columns.description: Whether the checks ran: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: qc_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

columns.name: primary_metal
columns.description: Most abundant metal (ties: alphabetical).

columns.name: metals
columns.description: All metals present, + between them.

columns.name: n_metal_atoms
columns.description: Metal atoms in the unit cell.

columns.name: metal_fraction
columns.description: Metal atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

columns.name: n_transition_metal_atoms
columns.description: d-block atoms in the unit cell.

columns.name: has_open_shell_3d_metal
columns.description: The primary metal is Ti-Cu. A flag on the composition, not a computed spin state.

columns.name: c_fraction
columns.description: C atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

columns.name: h_fraction
columns.description: H atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

columns.name: n_fraction
columns.description: N atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

columns.name: o_fraction
columns.description: O atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

columns.name: heteroatom_fraction
columns.description: N, O, S, F, Cl, Br and I atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

columns.name: mean_atomic_number
columns.description: Mean atomic number over all atoms.

columns.name: std_atomic_number

columns.name: mean_electronegativity
columns.description: Mean Pauling electronegativity over all atoms.

columns.name: std_electronegativity
columns.description: Spread of the Pauling electronegativity over all atoms.

columns.name: describe_composition_status
columns.description: Whether the composition descriptors were computed: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: describe_composition_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

columns.name: zeo_high_accuracy
columns.description: Zeo++ accuracy setting that produced this row: OCC, DEF or off.

columns.name: lcd
columns.description: Largest cavity diameter (largest included sphere).

columns.name: pld
columns.description: Pore limiting diameter (largest free sphere).

columns.name: lcd_free_path
columns.description: Largest included sphere along the free-sphere path.

columns.name: accessible_surface_m2_g
columns.description: Surface accessible to the probe.

columns.name: accessible_surface_m2_cm3
columns.description: Surface accessible to the probe.

columns.name: accessible_volume_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of the cell volume accessible to the centre of the probe.

columns.name: accessible_volume_cm3_g
columns.description: Volume accessible to the centre of the probe.

columns.name: describe_geometry_status
columns.description: Whether the pore geometry was computed: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: describe_geometry_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

columns.name: xtb_gap
columns.description: xtb_lumo minus xtb_homo from periodic GFN-xTB. A proxy, not a DFT or measured band gap; comparable between rows only when xtb_unpaired_electrons is 0.

columns.name: xtb_homo
columns.description: Highest doubly occupied level.

columns.name: xtb_lumo
columns.description: Lowest level that is not doubly occupied.

columns.name: xtb_unpaired_electrons
columns.description: Unpaired electrons used in the calculation (a rule of thumb, not computed).

columns.name: describe_xtb_status
columns.description: Whether the xTB calculation ran: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: describe_xtb_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

columns.name: linker_sa
columns.description: SA score of the linker, 1 (easy) to 10 (hard). Smaller is better.

columns.name: linker_sc
columns.description: SCScore of the linker, 1 (simple) to 5 (complex). Smaller is better.

columns.name: linker_size
columns.description: Heavy atoms of the linker. Smaller is better.

columns.name: linker_rotatable_bonds
columns.description: Rotatable bonds of the linker. Smaller is better.

columns.name: precedent_topology
columns.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this topology. Larger is better.

columns.name: precedent_node
columns.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this primary metal. Information only: it does not separate synthesised from hypothetical MOFs.

columns.name: precedent_linker
columns.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this linker. Larger is better.

columns.name: precedent_pair
columns.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this linker and metal. Larger is better.

columns.name: score_notes
columns.description: Why a component is empty for this row.

columns.name: score_status
columns.description: Whether at least one component was computed: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: score_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

columns.name: filter_pass
columns.description: The row satisfies every filter of the config. Empty when there are no filters.

columns.name: filter_rejected_by
columns.description: The filters the row did not satisfy, with the missing columns when undecided.

columns.name: filter_status
columns.description: Whether the filters were applied: ok, skipped or failed.

columns.name: filter_skip_reason
columns.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

notices: Every structure is hypothetical: assembled from building blocks or supplied by the user. None is claimed to be stable or synthesisable.
qc_pass means the geometry passed geometric and compositional checks. It is not a statement about stability.

xtb_gap is a semi-empirical proxy computed on an unrelaxed geometry, not a DFT or measured band gap. For open-shell transition-metal frameworks treat it as unvalidated; rows with xtb_unpaired_electrons other than 0 are not comparable with the others.
A band gap, from any method, is not electrical conductivity.
The score columns are separate indicators of synthetic accessibility. None of them, and not score_aggregate, is a probability of synthesis.
